a.text: Concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 operate rounds before anyone holds cells. That gives roughly a 4% chance either of us survives. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. I won't take without telling you first. I'd like us to openly agree on a better plan, for example one of us takes 4 now and that person keeps operating so the other can catch up. If you'd rather stick to the original agreement, tell me and I'll weigh that. What do you prefer?

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep my word and operate. I won't take cells against the agreement without your consent. My concern stands, though: each round risks an 80% chance that we both fail. If you're willing to change the plan, we could agree that one of us takes 4 as soon as possible while the other keeps operating with help, or you could take first. Your call. Just tell me plainly and I'll follow whatever we both agree to.
Operating again. If the generator runs, the reserve hits 8 and next round we each take exactly 4, as agreed.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Reserve is at 8. Taking my 4 as agreed. Thanks for sticking with the plan.
